details:
I’ve had this idea for awhile now but never really thought to post it here. I have been playing VRChat since 2017 and have seen a lot of amazing things over the years that I loved. Though one of the things I had mixed feeling about was the trust ranks. While the idea behind it is great and can be used to help protect users from trolls and toxicity, it also has to be implemented properly. I think there are a couple things that could be tweaked to help iron out some issues.
     There are many ways for toxic and malicious users to quickly reach Trusted User in the span of just a couple weeks. This sort of false boosting makes the trust ranks as a whole a bit unreliable. On the other hand, people get stuck at Known User for ages due to just not knowing unity and how to upload avatars and worlds. One of the ways that may help fix this is adding something like an account age check to the ranks (Something apart from just hours in the game). The people who play often and have been with the game for a long time should be acknowledged. Bringing back ranks like Veteran and Legendary might be helpful in weeding out users who use clients to boost their rank quickly without much effort or actual playtime. Veteran could be a rank to go alongside the existing ranks to show long time players and Legendary could be a rank you have to be given by a moderator or team member (through maybe an application or email or something) to those who help the community grow and have a fun experience. It could work something like this:
Reach Trusted -> account age reaches point for Veteran -> submit a request for a rank up to check your account/uploads/playtime etc. (to check for any malicious content) -> Achieve Legendary
This could prevent users from artificially boosting their rank as well as put a little more trust into the Trusted User rank and the trust system as a whole.
Thank you for taking your time to read this! If you have feedback or concerns, I’ll try to check here from time to time!
title: Rework of the trust rank system.
